settings.label: Product Card promo text
settings.info: One message per line. Leave empty to hide this text on product cards.

settings.content: Copy for the designer fragrance finder. The homepage band is the "FUEL_06 Fragrance finder" section; on product pages the finder opens from the link under the buy button. Copy is in the store's main language. No prices are set here: the finder reads them from each product.

settings.label: Product templates
settings.info: Product templates that show the finder, comma separated (the part after product.). Leave bundle templates out: their pages then load none of the finder.

settings.label: Scent tag prefix
settings.info: Prefix of the product tags that name a scent family, e.g. duft: or scent:. Used for the "similar scents" suggestions.

settings.label: Product page link: link text
settings.default: Find your designer scent for less

settings.label: Band heading
settings.default: Find your designer scent for less

settings.label: Heading word in green
settings.info: The first time this word appears in the band heading it is set in green italics. Leave it empty for a plain heading.

settings.label: Finder title
settings.default: Find your designer scent for less

settings.label: Search field label
settings.default: Search for a perfume you already love

settings.label: Popular searches
settings.info: Separated by commas. Replace with the real top search terms from the Searchanise report.
settings.default: Dior Sauvage, Baccarat Rouge 540, Creed Aventus, YSL Black Opium, Bleu de Chanel, JPG Le Male

settings.label: How it works steps
settings.info: One step per line. They are numbered automatically.
settings.default:
Search for a scent you already love
We find the MagyX scent that comes closest
Compare the scent and what you save

settings.label: Close button label
settings.info: Read out by screen readers, not shown on screen.

settings.label: Loading subtitle
settings.default: Comparing scent profile, notes and customer favourites.

settings.label: Loading footnote
settings.default: Our matching looks at thousands of reviews and scent data points to find your perfect match.

settings.label: Result subtitle prefix
settings.info: The fragrance the shopper searched for is added after this.

settings.label: Inspired by prefix
settings.info: Never change this to a claim that our perfume is the same as the designer one.

settings.label: Note row labels
settings.info: Three labels separated by commas, in this order: top, heart, base. Kept short so they fit the 64px label column.

settings.label: Our column note
settings.info: Concentration of our own bottle. It is printed after the size the variant carries, so "100ML" and "Extrait de parfum" read as "100ML / Extrait de parfum".

settings.label: Designer column note
settings.info: Size and concentration of the designer bottle the price refers to. Change it as soon as one figure cannot stand for every fragrance.

settings.label: Savings percentage suffix
settings.info: The percentage is worked out from the product's own prices and printed before this word.

settings.label: Remove recent search label
settings.info: Read out by screen readers on the cross beside a remembered search, not shown on screen.

settings.label: Add to cart label
settings.info: The price is added after this, from the product itself.

settings.label: Search again label
settings.default: Not the right scent? Search again

settings.label: No result title
settings.info: The design has no no-result frame. This wording is a placeholder for Omar and Korana to replace.

settings.label: No result text
settings.default: We couldn't find that scent. Try another name or pick one of the popular searches.

settings.label: Add to cart error
settings.default: Something went wrong. Please try again.
